calibration_scope: frozen policy and declared synthetic independent-history mixture

definitions.actual_margin: min wrong full-SSE loss minus true full-SSE loss after H+N refit; signed
definitions.actual_effect: design signed margin minus fixed-site constant signed margin, paired same history
definitions.predicted_gain: full selected half-SSE score minus site-zero constant score
definitions.correlation: descriptive Pearson/Spearman over valid paired independent histories; constant inputs NA
definitions.plan_match: exact equality of p,q,sites,soc arrays; array matches counted separately
definitions.accepted_steps: all accepted full-search steps across sites and starts; material gain exceeds 1e-6
definitions.impedance: successful true-topology fits; support-aligned pooled squared errors by edge class
definitions.relative_rmse: divide each error by its own true parameter; small weak branches amplify this ratio
definitions.fit_timing: historical fit-bank seconds; joint sum of saved per-fit diagnostic seconds, excluding selector
definitions.design_truth_coverage: evaluation-only check among activated histories with known true candidate
definitions.risk: existing frozen threshold and declared synthetic mixture only; no new confidence claim
